description: 100 concurrent createFact calls over a 10x10 entity fan-out produce exactly 100 fact_history 'created' rows — no loss, no duplication, monotonic occurred_at ordering per fact_id.

concurrency_config.selection_strategy: each worker picks uniform-random (subject, object, predicate); collisions on triple are permitted because each worker uses a distinct fact UUID

mutation_sequence.description: Harness spawns 100 workers; each calls createFact with actor='graph_agent', reasoning='race-iter-<N>'.
Harness waits for all worker promises to settle before running assertions.

assertions.because: Every worker must have committed its own fact
Every createFact must write exactly one audit row
NOT NULL columns must not be null
Every iteration must leave its trace and no iteration index can repeat

assertions.description: for every fact_id, occurred_at monotonic (ties permitted, inversions not)

related_non_adversarial_variants.purpose: 1000-mutation volume hardening; all writes must persist

graduation_notes: Promote to L2 after 3 consecutive passes with 0% lost/duplicate audit rows and p99 < 250ms. L2 increases fan-out to 100x100 and concurrency to 500 workers.
